title: Probe Run
description: One execution of services/probe-runner: all regions probed once, region-agreement computed, and a false-positive-vs-incident decision made. Posted by probe-runner's PORT_WEBHOOK_URL call (see services/probe-runner/src/port.ts).

confidence.title: False-Positive Confidence
confidence.description: 0..1 confidence this failure is a false positive (stale assertions after a frontend change) rather than a real incident. Only meaningful when decision != healthy.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Human-readable explanation of the decision, from services/probe-runner/src/decision.ts — keep this visible in the UI, it's the whole point of the scoring function being explainable.
